Hotel Arts Barcelona is getting a hotel of its own at the top. Marriott International has unveiled Casa dels Artistes, a 60-suite boutique hotel set in the upper floors of Hotel Arts Barcelona, the Ritz-Carlton tower on the seafront. The announcement was published on 26 November 2026, and the opening is set for June 2027. The exact day is still to be confirmed.

## A private house in the sky

The interiors are by the American designer Ken Fulk, known for The Goodtime Hotel in Miami and ZZ's Club in New York. Marriott describes the project as a private abode in the sky, drawing on Catalan culture, Modernisme, mythology and nature, with collected art and craftsmanship throughout.

The 60 suites have private terraces, and two of them are penthouses, each with its own personality. On the 40th floor, guests will find a sea-facing pool, restaurants and bars, and cultural experiences, with views over Barcelona and the Mediterranean. The names of the restaurants, their chefs and the room rates have not been announced.

## Hotel Arts keeps moving

Hotel Arts, home of Frank Gehry's golden fish sculpture, has been renovating its rooms and suites with the Meyer Davis studio since 2024. The final phase runs until May 2027, with some indoor and outdoor spaces partly closed. Marriott has given neither the investment figure nor the name of the owner.

## The signal

A hotel within a hotel is becoming a luxury play in big cities: the top floors become a separate, more private address, with their own design and their own price point. With Ken Fulk at the helm, Hotel Arts is betting on design to bring a new clientele to the Barcelona waterfront.
summary: Marriott unveils Casa dels Artistes, a 60-suite hotel designed by Ken Fulk in the upper floors of Hotel Arts Barcelona, opening in June 2027.
title: Casa dels Artistes: a 60-suite hotel atop Hotel Arts Barcelona
why: A design-led hotel within a hotel on Barcelona's seafront, by Ken Fulk.
